verdict.rationale: Relay documents multi-step approval rules, automated approvals, role-based banking access, and a dedicated support article on setting up payment approvals, which directly supports finance-lead-controlled approval permissions. However, none of the docs explicitly describe a 'one-click' approve-and-send flow, and community feedback notes some users experienced issues with permissions settings. Missing for 10: explicit one-click approval UX documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of smooth permission setup.
